name: Home
brief:
Service: Home. Controls devices in a house.

Data:
- DeviceKind: one of light, lock, thermostat
- Device: id (text), name (text), kind (a DeviceKind)
- Setting: deviceId (text), previous (decimal number), current (decimal number)

Actions:
- listDevices() returns a list of Device. Only reads.
- setTemperature(deviceId: text, celsius: decimal number) returns a Setting. Changes data. Can be undone with restore, for one hour afterwards.
- restore(setting: Setting) returns nothing. Changes data. Cannot be undone.
- unlock(deviceId: text, minutes: whole number) returns nothing. Changes data. Cannot be undone.

Use exactly these action, parameter, type, and field names.
